scope: Proposition 13.1 (Ordered full-box transport) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 61-62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Di, Si be finite families of closed rational axis-aligned boxes in R3 with positive side lengths, pairwise disjoint within each family. Suppose the assigned center-to-center affine map Fi satisfies Fi(Di) = Si and has positive diagonal linear part Ai of determinant one. There is an effective compactly supported solenoidal unit-time field, zero near the time endpoints, whose time-one map has this action on every full Di. If both centers of a 61 pair have negative third coordinate, every point of Di whose third coordinate equals that of its center follows a path with negative third coordinate.
